proved: Actual identity-cotangent vanishing for a smooth group morphism yields vanishing pulled-back universal differentials and a unique actual relative Frobenius factor over an algebraically closed field.

For an abelian variety over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p, zero actual Verschiebung cotangent is equivalent to V factoring through F on the actual first twist; the residual factor is an actual scheme and group-scheme isomorphism from the double twist.

For every presented separable quintic/sextic in odd characteristic over an algebraically closed field, matrix zero and Cartier zero on the entire regular/global differential space are equivalent to the actual residual-isomorphism factorization criterion, for every representing Jacobian and base point.

The actual subgroup ker(F on the first twist) intersect ker(V) is finite flat, closed, killed by p and supported at one geometric point. At p-rank zero and positive dimension its cotangent space is nonzero.
The actual Verschiebung kernel at p-rank zero has one geometric point and scheme length p^g; its cotangent space agrees with that of the simultaneous subgroup.

The actual fibre cotangent sequence is exact, and dim Cot(ker F intersect ker V)=g-rank(dV). For a surface of p-rank zero with nonzero dV this dimension is one. For presented genus-two models C squared zero and C nonzero gives dimension one, while C zero gives dimension two.
In characteristic three, every presented separable genus-two quintic or sextic has nonzero Cartier and is not geometrically superspecial.
